description: Replay daily ribbons for the active character in game 1.24 without changing game state. For this paired save, independent bounds show that the active character matches the website's highest account-wide Ribbon Winning bonus. Check this match again if the save or active character changes. Calculate ribbon counts across rounding thresholds. Combine all 128 outcomes of the seven rank rolls with the other rank sources. Do not roll random values or run a daily reset.
target: Cooking daily ribbon quantity at the highest account-wide talent bonus, plus daily ribbon rank probabilities

extractions.expression: (()=>{const f=(name,...args)=>idleon.callFunction(name,...args);const a=name=>idleon.getAttr(name);const bundles=a('BundlesReceived').h;const paletteParts=[[Math.min(3,Math.floor(palette)),1-(palette-Math.floor(palette))],[Math.min(3,Math.floor(palette)+1),palette-Math.floor(palette)]];const countProb=new Map();for(const[q,prob]of count=enabled?[...countProb].reduce((s,[n,p])=>s+n*p,0):0;const paletteMean=paletteParts.reduce((s,[q,p])=>s+q*p,0);const countAmounts=[['base',1],['dailyRoll',0.5],['legendTalent',legend],['eventShop',3*event],['deathBringerBundle',Math.min(5,5*death)],['boaringBundle',Math.min(5,5*boaring)],['ribbonWinningTalent',talent],['palette',paletteMean]];const additiveTotal=countAmounts.reduce((s,[,v])=>s+v,0);const baseTotal=base;const additionalTotal=.5+talent+paletteMean;const countBreakdown={sources:countAmounts.map(([source,amount])=>{const group=['dailyRoll','ribbonWinningTalent','palette'].includes(source)?'additional':'base';const groupTotal=group==='base'?baseTotal:additionalTotal;return{source,group,amount,active:amount!==0,share:groupTotal===0?0:amount/groupTotal};}),baseTotal,additionalTotal,additiveTotal,meritocracyMultiplier:merit,meritocracyImpact:1-1/merit,expectedRawCount:merit*baseTotal+additionalTotal,roundingAdjustment:count-(merit*baseTotal+additionalTotal),total:count};const p=Math.min(.65,.1+(grimoire+15*death)/100);let ranks=new Map();for(let mask=0;mask<128;mask++){let rank=1;let probability=1;for(let trial=0;trial<7;trial++)probability*=mask&(1<<trial)?p:1-p;for(let trial=0;trial<7;trial++){if(mask&(1<<trial))rank++;else if(trial>=2)break;}ranks.set(rank,(ranks.get(rank)||0)+probability);}const mean=m=>[...m].reduce((s,[n,p])=>s+n*p,0);const rankAmounts=[['base',1],['grimoire',mean(ranks)-1]];const apply=(source,outcomes)=>{rankAmounts.push([source,outcomes.reduce((s,[n,p])=>s+n*p,0)]);const next=new Map();for(const[r,p]of smoky=Math.max(0,f('Summoning2','BonusAmountcook',3,99)/100);const smokyLow=Math.floor(smoky);const smokyFraction=smoky-smokyLow;apply('smoky',[[Math.min(3,smokyLow),1-smokyFraction],[Math.min(3,smokyLow+1),smokyFraction]]);const armory=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f('RoyalG','ArmoryUpgBonus',82,0)+25*f('Summoning','EventShopOwned',51,0))/100));apply('armoryEventShop',[[0,1-armory],[1,armory]]);const extractions.description: Sources: DailyResetTick.1.24.js, getbonus2.1.24.js, RunCodeOfTypeXforThingY.1.24.js, and TalentCalc.1.24.js. For this paired save, independent bounds confirm that the active character has the highest account-wide Ribbon Winning bonus. The nativeActiveContext field records that character's inputs and results. A failed rank roll ends the sequence from the third roll onward. The companion uses a 10% roll, then an independent 45% roll if the first fails. Ranks above 20 become rank 2. Keep probability values at full precision.
